acceptanceCriteria: An assertion only reachable through a shared example is flagged
Strength counts expectations inside the cited example body and flags stubs on described_class
MEMOIZED-BLOCK-EXPECTATION and ISOLATED-IN-SERIAL findings flow end to end into test-validity output (closes V1-1787); TSA-V0 amended
body: GitHub #1128 hygiene and strength asks. After PR #1125 (static RSpec rules) and the Ruby provider (S4), test-validity still lacks hygiene (skip, pending, xit, focus, shared-example indirection) and strength (expectations inside the example body; allow/expect(described_class).to receive making expectations tautological) projection for RSpec, and the #1125 findings have no user surface (V1-1787).
title: GH #1128 / #1130 S5: RSpec hygiene and strength axes in test-validity from the Ruby provider
